text:
incident-bot: PAGER — metering counter drift detected (severity: P1). A subset of emitters showing >2x token counts across embed-service -> aggregator. Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/incident-metering-drift|metering-drift>. Paging oncall.
alex: oncall ack. I’m looking.
maria: I can take the handoff if alex would like to jump to infra. tell me where we are seeing the spike.
alex: thanks. root looks like emitter-v2 -> retry window duplicates. initial graph: cpu/emit-rate spikes and token-counts double. Links: <https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/emit-token-delta?range=15m>
raj: quick check — running an aggregate query on the recent window shows counts that align with 2x of expected for several customer keys:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as reported, sum(tokens)/sum(expected_tokens) as ratio
FROM billing.emit_15m
WHERE emitted_at > now() - interval '20 minutes'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
raj: output -> ratios ~1.9–2.3 for top 5 customers. suspect duplicate ack path in emitter retry handler.
maria: good repro. mitigation options: (1) flip traffic to emitter-v1 (fallback), (2) disable emitter dedupe-ack path (hotfix), (3) pause emitter-to-aggregator pipeline (riskier). prefer (1) or (2).
ops-runner: I can flip traffic to v1 via the canary router. preparing switch + will annotate with rollback trigger.
lisa-cs: quick question — are customers receiving overage flags / alerts right now? we need to know who to notify.
billing-eng: some customers already hit overage thresholds and flags were emitted (~34 accounts). pulling the list now — will paste shortly.
ops-runner: executing traffic flip to emitter-v1 -> canary router (command):
```bash
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/route/switch \
  -d '{"service":"emitter","from":"v2","to":"v1","reason":"incident-1758882222"}'
```
ops-runner: flipped. routing reports 94% -> v1 within 90s.
raj: re-running the SQL query now -> ratios back to ~1.0–1.05. token ingestion rate normalized on telemetry.
maria: nice. can we confirm aggregator ids and de-dup table caught any duplicates? if so, backfill may be required.
billing-eng: dedupe table shows ~9k duplicate entries in the 18–22 minute window. estimating potential billed token delta ~120k tokens across those 34 accounts. low dollar impact but noisy flags.
lisa-cs: thanks. we will send a proactive note to affected customers: short transparent update and reassurance about crediting for false overage flags. prepping message with billing-eng.
billing-eng: agreed — we’ll create a temporary reconciliation job to subtract deduped tokens and mark flags for auto-clear. ETA 45m.
alex: good mitigation — routing rollback avoided pausing pipeline. next steps: postmortem owner? maria take lead? alex help w/ infra timeline.
maria: I’ll own the postmortem. initial RCA: emitter-v2 retry handler introduced idempotency gap when upstream ACK race occurs under short-lived backpressure. action items: revert hot path, add end-to-end test for retry idempotency, improve alerting thresholds (emit delta >1.2x), and add automatic pausing of overage alerts during ingestion anomalies.
ops-runner: reconciliation job started. monitoring shows customer flags will auto-clear once job completes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated. root cause identified as emitter-v2 retry idempotency regression. status: mitigation in prod (routing fallback), reconciliation running. Severity: reduced to P2. postmortem owner: maria. Follow-up channel: #postmortems-metering.
lisa-cs: customer comms drafted, will send after billing-eng confirms reconciliation plan. thanks team :thumbsup:
maria: wrapping up. last check shows token-rate stable and no new overage flags in the last 10m.
alex: marking handoff complete. oncall clear unless pager fires again.
incident-bot: incident closed (TS: 1758882444). Please add notes to runbook and link postmortem when ready.
